pairs: Dilectus meus descendit in hortum suum ad areolam aromatum,
Bride: My beloved has descended to his garden, to the courtyard of aromatic plants,
ut pascatur in hortis, et lilia colligat.
in order to pasture in the gardens and gather the lilies.
and my beloved is for me.
terrible, like an army in battle array.
for they have caused me to fly away.
Capilli tui sicut grex caprarum quæ apparuerunt de Galaad.
Your hair is like a flock of goats, which have appeared out of Gilead.
Dentes tui sicut grex ovium quæ ascenderunt de lavacro:
Your teeth are like a flock of sheep, which have ascended from the washing,
each one with its identical twin,
et sterilis non est in eis.
and not one among them is barren.
Like the skin of a pomegranate,
elect is she who bore her.
and they proclaimed her most blessed.
The queens and concubines saw her,
Quæ est ista quæ progreditur quasi aurora consurgens,
Chorus to Groom: Who is she, who advances like the rising dawn,
as terrible as an army in battle array?
I descended to the garden of nuts,
in order to see the fruits of the steep valleys,
and to examine whether the vineyard had flourished and the pomegranates had produced buds.
anima mea conturbavit me, propter quadrigas Aminadab.
My soul was stirred up within me because of the chariots of Amminadab.
so that we may consider you.
